title: Check what you need to apply for a building permit

paragraphs: You will need property and construction details to fill out your building permit application.

sections.heading: What we need from you › 1. You and your project team
paragraphs: Professionals working on the project, like an architect, contractor, or engineer and their license number and expiration date
Anyone else on the project team

sections.heading: What we need from you › 2. Building location
paragraphs: We will ask you about your building site:
Look up your block and lot number through our property information map using your street address.
Block and lot number are also called parcel. If a parcel number is 0000/111, then the block number is 0000 and the lot number is 111.

sections.heading: What we need from you › 3. Project plan
paragraphs: We will ask you about your project plan including:
Type of construction (See our construction type definitions )
You can also tell us your construction lender name, branch designation, and address.

sections.heading: What we need from you › 4. Construction details
paragraphs: We will ask you if your project will:
Add a driveway (also called an auto runway)
Create additional height or stories to the building
Create a deck or horizontal extension to the building

sections.heading: What we need from you › New construction (In-House review projects)
paragraphs: For new construction for in-house review projects , we will ask about:
Building location relative to nearby streets

sections.heading: What we need from you › Addenda
paragraphs: For In-House review projects, if you are submitting addenda to site permit originally submitted electronically, follow these instructions.

sections.heading: What we need from you › Legal terms
paragraphs: You will need to tell us about your worker’s compensation insurance and agree to our legal terms.
